Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the author of the manga series featuring Ichitaka Seto as Masakazu Katsura. Ichitaka Seto is the protagonist of the manga *Blue Period*, not *I's*. *Blue Period* is written and illustrated by Tsubasa Yamaguchi (born 1994), while Masakazu Katsura is the author of *I's*, which features a different protagonist (Kazuki Ichinose). This fundamental factual error regarding the character and series name led the entire multi-agent process to search for the wrong person's birth year.
